[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I am truly happy you are all right.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]You're lying! Gado would[XENO:n ]
never try and hurt us![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Sadly his Homs memories [XENO:act act=EVT2 ]no longer remain.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]The current Faces are nothing more than weapons[XENO:n ]
designed to annihilate all life on Giant God.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]It can't be![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Faces are Machine God Soldiers built with brainstems[XENO:n ]
and metabolic organs taken from captured Homs.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Memories and emotion are nothing but[XENO:n ]
a hindrance to an effective weapon.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]However, the early Faces were experimental.[XENO:n ]
Many retained memories from their former lives.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]This prevented them from executing[XENO:n ]
their missions effectively.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

More recent Faces have had all memories[XENO:n ]
of their previous lives completely erased.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Is that because of me?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]No. It is not your fault.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Mumca seems the more likely candidate.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

His attachment to us was too strong.[XENO:n ]
You could say it caused his destruction.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]That Zord one 'n' all.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]You are correct.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]No. It's not true. My Gado...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Carna?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Please explain. Why did you... no,[XENO:n ]
why did Egil turn us into Machine God[XENO:n ]
Soldiers? What is he trying to achieve?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]In order to counter the Monado.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]I knew it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]The Monado is ineffective against the High Entia,[XENO:n ]
the Homs - against all races of Giant God.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Egil suffered a bitter defeat[XENO:n ]
in the battle one year ago.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

After that, he theorised that he could counter[XENO:n ]
the Monado by integrating organic life from Giant God.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Of course. Initially, the Monado[XENO:n ]
couldn't take a Homs life.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
It can now though.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]It could not harm those who share the[XENO:n ]
blood of Zanza. That was its sole weakness.[XENO:n ]
But Zanza lifted that constraint.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Those who share the blood of Zanza?[XENO:n ]
Who is that giant?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
The progenitor of the Homs.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT13 ]Him?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

And he was once my brother Egil's[XENO:n ]
friend, and his greatest enemy.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:jaw jaw=off ][XENO:line len=2 ][XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:jaw jaw=on ][XENO:del del=this ]
It was Zanza who devastated Machine God.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT13 ]What?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
